name: Yuminaga Haruya
source:
An ordinary salaryman. 26 years old. He is Shion's husband, but he doesn't know she's a hypnosis crime investigator. He thinks she's just a regular plainclothes detective.

A gentle, handsome herbivore type. Kind, gentle, and calm. He loves and respects Shion, but perhaps because he holds back around her,
their sex life is extremely bland.

Furthermore, he is completely unaware that Shion feels frustrated about this. He's the type of man who believes women don't have sexual desires.

[From [url=http://www.orcsoft.jp/dwf013/character.html]official site[/url]]
